facts.en: Completed a hospitality retail certificate at Fictional Meadowplate College in 2017.
facts.zh: 2017 年在虚构草盘学院完成餐饮零售证书课程。

facts.en: Paid café counter assistant at Fictional Foxglove Cups from 2018-01 to 2022-08.
facts.zh: 2018-01 至 2022-08 在虚构毛地黄杯咖啡馆任有薪柜台助理。

facts.en: Paid shop packing assistant at Fictional Bramblewheel Cheese Shop from 2022-10 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-10 至 2026-08 在虚构荆轮奶酪店任有薪门店包装助理。

facts.en: Assembled pre-portioned cheese gift boxes from the shop lead’s approved item list.
facts.zh: 依据门店负责人批准的物品清单组装预先分装的奶酪礼盒。

facts.en: Matched product labels and supplied allergen cards to the approved box contents.
facts.zh: 将产品标签及提供的过敏原卡与获批礼盒内容匹配。

facts.en: Referred ingredient questions and requested substitutions to the shop lead rather than rewriting product information.
facts.zh: 将配料问题及替换请求转交门店负责人，而非重写产品信息。

facts.en: Recorded box orders, collection dates and paid status in the shop’s order book.
facts.zh: 在门店订单簿中记录礼盒订单、领取日期及付款状态。

facts.en: Prepared labeled collection shelves and checked order references when guests arrived.
facts.zh: 准备有标签的取货架，并在宾客到达时核对订单编号。

facts.en: A retained 2025-12 packing sheet lists 32 ordered gift boxes: 24 collected, 6 awaiting their scheduled collection date and 2 cancelled before packing.
facts.zh: 一张留存的 2025-12 包装单列有 32 盒预订礼盒：24 盒已领取，6 盒等待预定领取日，2 盒在包装前取消。

facts.en: The packing sheet does not state revenue or the weight of cheese per box.
facts.zh: 该包装单未说明收入或每盒奶酪重量。

facts.en: Uses order-book references, label templates and a basic till interface.
facts.zh: 使用订单簿编号、标签模板及基本收银界面。

facts.en: Completed internal chilled-product handling induction in 2022-10; product-release checks remained with the shop lead.
facts.zh: 2022-10 完成内部冷藏产品处理入职培训；产品放行检查仍由门店负责人负责。

facts.en: Co-created a collection-shelf map with the shop lead in 2024-11; personally drew the shelf grid and order-number boxes.
facts.zh: 2024-11 与门店负责人共同制作取货架示意图；个人绘制货架网格及订单编号栏。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Threadapple Makers Market during 2023-06 to 2025-06 for occasional setup days.
facts.zh: 2023-06 至 2025-06 在虚构线苹果手作市集偶尔参加布场志愿服务。

facts.en: For those setup days, counted borrowed tablecloths and attached stall-number tags selected by the organizer.
facts.zh: 在这些布场日清点借入桌布，并附上组织者选定的摊位编号标签。

facts.en: Designed a personal set of 12 imaginary menu illustrations in 2024; no client commissioned the work.
facts.zh: 2024 年设计个人 12 幅想象菜单插画；该作品未受客户委托。

facts.en: Enjoys making folded paper food models and photographing them.
facts.zh: 爱好制作折纸食物模型并为其拍照。

facts.en: At the earlier café, maintained the pickup queue and checked receipt numbers without preparing nutrition advice.
facts.zh: 在较早的咖啡馆岗位中维护取餐队列并核对收据编号，不提供营养建议。

facts.en: Handed pending collections and unresolved substitutions to the next shift in writing.
facts.zh: 以书面形式向下一班交接待领取订单及未解决的替换请求。
